rationale: The change introduces an explicit configurable braking-zone definition for the dangerous zone while stating that the concern and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged. This intersects the basis of H1-ORR3 because its assumption H1-A3 and revalidation condition H1-RC3 explicitly depend on the distance or spatial-information requirement and the dangerous-zone definition. H1-ORR1 and H1-ORR2 are not affected because the change does not alter obstacle presence or the object-category distinction.
